source.changes: SRD 5.2.1 pp. 230–233 adapted into twelve versioned magic-item families (Manual of Quickness of Action through Oil of Etherealness) with explicit variant identities, structured requirements and typed source values. Names, numeric rules and key phrases are adapted into keys; no rules prose is reproduced. Prices are not listed and remain unspecified. Catalogue data grants no inventory, action or gameplay permissions; every record is unavailable.
